idea-plugin.name: Veyra Neon Vice
idea-plugin.description:
Code like it's a neon night in an 80s beach city. Hot-pink and electric-cyan neon over a deep purple night, with a sunset of yellow and orange. Plus a bright daylight version.

Two themes

  • Veyra Neon Vice: a deep purple night lit by neon. Hot-pink keywords, electric-cyan strings, sunset-yellow functions, violet types, mint fields and orange numbers.
  • Veyra Neon Vice Daylight: the same city by day, on a crisp white editor with deepened colours for contrast.

Every pixel themed

  • The whole IDE: toolbars, tool windows, tabs, popups, Search Everywhere, dialogs, the Run widget and notifications, 1,200+ UI keys in one palette. On 2025.3 and newer you get the rounded Islands look.
  • Signature details: a pink-to-orange sunset default button, a hot-pink tab underline, an electric-cyan caret, a pink current line number and a pink-to-cyan progress bar.
  • Matching editor colour schemes for Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, Go, Rust, PHP, Markdown and more, plus the debugger, diffs, VCS, search highlights and the terminal.
  • Easy to read: every syntax colour meets WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) on its background, comments included.

How to use it

Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Appearance → Theme and pick Veyra Neon Vice or Veyra Neon Vice Daylight. The matching editor colour scheme switches with it.

Made by FlightCoders, the team behind Veyra Studio. More themes: Veyra Aurora and Veyra Theme.
